clips.content:
---
# REQUIRED: Visible title for cards + page
title: TITLE_GOES_HERE

home:
  enable: true
  grid:
	rows: 1
	columns: 2

preview:
  enable: true
  grid:
	rows: 1
	columns: 1

# REQUIRED: Full-bleed card background image
background: '../../../assets/content/backgrounds/BACKGROUND_IMAGE.jpg'

# OPTIONAL: Foreground image used on cards
screenshot:
  image: '../../../assets/content/visual/PATH/SCREENSHOT_IMAGE.png'
  altText: 'SHORT DESCRIPTION'

# OPTIONAL: Icon used in legacy cards or future UI
icon: '../../../assets/content/SVGs/ICON_NAME.svg'

# REQUIRED: Appears under card title
platforms:
  - Graphic Design

# REQUIRED: Determines section (ux, visual, photo, sound)
disciplines:
  - visual

# Optional: lower numbers appear earlier
order: 999
---

{/* Required for clickable images */}
import LightboxImage from '../../../components/LightboxImage.astro';
